comment: Keys, values and messages of the Core 2 shop (WP-17, docs/design/11): the profile's shops content and module, the stock a run keeps among its reward offers, the open-shop marker and the web's purchase sentences.

keySets.name: Core2ShopKeys
keySets.doc: Keys the Core 2 shop reads and writes: the shops content and module (web model/gameProfileRewards.js gameProfileShopStock) and the run's open-shop marker (main.js showShop).

keySets.name: Core2ShopValues
keySets.doc: String values the Core 2 shop writes: the stock's offer id prefix and the shop id's separator.

keySets.name: Core2ShopMessages
keySets.doc: The web's shop sentences (the errors a purchase throws) and the door's own refusals.
